senses.en: the way someone acts; British spelling

ex.en: The behaviour in the hall was calm.
ex.zh: 礼堂里的行为很平静。

ex.en: Fair rules look at behaviour, not at who arrived in a quiet car.
ex.zh: 公平的规定看行为，而不是看谁坐着安静的车来的。

tip: behaviour 是英式，behavior 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留。通常不可数。

senses.en: happening most often

ex.en: She took the usual bus.
ex.zh: 她坐了平时那班车。

ex.en: The usual route fails on the day the bridge closes, so the notice must say the other way.
ex.zh: 桥关闭的那天平时的路线走不通，所以通知必须写出另一条路。

tip: as usual 表示和往常一样。usually 是副词。

senses.en: a planned way of doing something

ex.en: This method makes the experiment clearer.
ex.zh: 这个方法让实验更清楚。

ex.en: A teaching method that works in a small class may fail when forty students share one room.
ex.zh: 小班有效的教学方法，在四十个学生共用一间教室时可能失败。

tip: method 后接 of doing 或 for doing。

senses.en: to give money for something
money received for work

ex.en: I paid for the tickets online.
ex.zh: 我在网上付了票钱。

ex.en: Families who pay a large share of their income for rent have less left for books and clinics.
ex.zh: 把收入的很大一部分用来付房租的家庭，留给书和看病的钱就更少。

tip: pay 的过去式和过去分词是 paid。人作主语：sb pays for sth。

senses.en: an open public place in a town
having four equal sides, or multiplied by itself

ex.en: We met in the square outside the museum.
ex.zh: 我们在博物馆外的广场见面。

ex.en: A town square that bans bikes may feel tidy and still be harder for students to reach.
ex.zh: 禁止自行车的城镇广场也许看起来整齐，学生却更难到达。

tip: square 作形容词是方形的，也可指数学上的平方。

senses.en: having lived long, or not new

ex.en: This is an old map, but the river is the same.
ex.zh: 这是一张旧地图，但那条河还是一样的。

ex.en: Old buildings can teach a city what to keep when everything else is being rebuilt.
ex.zh: 当其他一切都在重建时，老建筑可以告诉一座城市该保留什么。

tip: 表示年龄用数字加 years old。兄姐用 elder 或 older 都可以。

senses.en: the lowest part

ex.en: The key is at the bottom of the bag.
ex.zh: 钥匙在包的底部。

ex.en: Notes at the bottom of a chart often explain the number that the headline left out.
ex.zh: 图表底部的注释，常常解释标题没写的那个数字。

tip: bottom 是最下面。from the bottom of one's heart 表示衷心。

senses.en: something done wrongly
to be wrong about something

ex.en: I made a mistake in the date.
ex.zh: 我把日期写错了。

ex.en: A mistake in the bus time should be corrected before parents leave work to meet it.
ex.zh: 公交时间的错误应当在家长下班来接之前改掉。

tip: by mistake 表示无意中做错。过去式 mistook，过去分词 mistaken。

senses.en: to say or do again

ex.en: Please repeat the time.
ex.zh: 请把时间再说一遍。

ex.en: Teachers repeat a warning when the first one was on a poster nobody could see.
ex.zh: 当第一次警告写在没人看得见的海报上时，老师会再讲一遍。

tip: repeat 后直接接内容，不说 repeat again 除非强调又一次。

senses.en: to greet someone in a friendly way
gladly received
a friendly greeting

ex.en: We welcome new students on the first day.
ex.zh: 我们在第一天欢迎新生。

ex.en: A town should welcome questions about a new road before the machines arrive.
ex.zh: 在机器到来之前，城镇应该欢迎关于新路的提问。

tip: welcome 作形容词是“受欢迎的”：You are welcome。

senses.en: to answer or react

ex.en: Please respond to the e-mail today.
ex.zh: 请今天回复这封电子邮件。

ex.en: Schools should respond to a broken step before they respond to a complaint about paint.
ex.zh: 学校应当先回应坏掉的台阶，再回应关于油漆的投诉。

tip: respond to something。表里这一行的音标是 respect，本库不用。

senses.en: a shared decision, or the state of agreeing

ex.en: The two classes reached an agreement about the hall.
ex.zh: 两个班就礼堂的使用达成了协议。

ex.en: An agreement on water use fails if nobody writes down who may pump on a dry day.
ex.zh: 如果没人写下干旱日谁可以抽水，用水协议就会失败。

tip: 达成协议用 reach 或 come to an agreement。

senses.en: a period of seven days

ex.en: We have a test next week.
ex.zh: 我们下周有一次测验。

ex.en: A four-day school week may cut costs, but it can also lengthen each remaining day beyond what children can manage.
ex.zh: 每周上四天课也许能省钱，但也可能把剩下的每天拉长到孩子承受不了。

tip: next week 前不加 the。

senses.en: a set of connected people, computers, or routes

ex.en: The bus network does not reach our village.
ex.zh: 公交网络到不了我们村。

ex.en: A phone network that fails in a storm leaves the people who need a warning without one.
ex.zh: 在风暴中失灵的电话网络，会让最需要警报的人收不到警报。

tip: network 可指计算机网络，也可指交通或人际网络。

senses.en: to have inside
to prevent something from spreading or becoming stronger

ex.en: This box may contain old letters.
ex.zh: 这个盒子里可能装有旧信。

ex.en: Processed foods often contain large amounts of salt, which can contribute to serious health problems.
ex.zh: 加工食品往往含有大量盐分，可能导致严重的健康问题。

tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语；表示“含有”时通常不用进行时。

senses.en: difficult, or strong and not easily broken

ex.en: The first chapter is tough, but it gets clearer.
ex.zh: 第一章很难，但后面会清楚些。

ex.en: A tough timetable is fairer when every class, not only the top set, can use the lab.
ex.zh: 艰难的课表若让每个班而不只是尖子班都能用实验室，就更公平。

tip: tough 可形容任务难，也可形容人或材料结实。表里音标是 totally，本库不用。

senses.en: very bad or strict

ex.en: The storm caused severe damage.
ex.zh: 暴风雨造成了严重损失。

ex.en: Severe rules without an explanation teach fear more than safety.
ex.zh: 没有解释的严厉规定，教给人们的是害怕多于安全。

tip: severe 比 serious 语气更强。

senses.en: before noon

ex.en: The reading room opens at 7 a.m.
ex.zh: 阅览室早上七点开门。

ex.en: Starting lessons at 7 a.m. may suit adults, but many teenagers are still at their sleepiest then.
ex.zh: 早上七点上课也许适合成年人，但许多青少年那时仍处于最困的时候。

tip: a.m. 表示午夜到中午；书写时数字与 a.m. 之间留空格。

senses.en: an informal hello

ex.en: She said hi to the new student.
ex.zh: 她向新同学说了声嗨。

ex.en: A friendly hi at the gate does not replace a safe road, but it can make the first day easier.
ex.zh: 门口一声友好的嗨替代不了安全的路，但能让第一天容易些。

tip: hi 比 hello 更随意，正式场合少用。

senses.en: a set of beliefs in a god or gods

ex.en: The class studies religion as history, not as a test of faith.
ex.zh: 这个班把宗教当历史来学，而不是信仰测验。

ex.en: A public school can explain a religion without telling students to join it.
ex.zh: 公立学校可以讲解一种宗教，而不要求学生加入。

tip: 形容词 religious 已在本库。

senses.en: a talk in which people share opinions

ex.en: The discussion lasted twenty minutes.
ex.zh: 讨论持续了二十分钟。

ex.en: A discussion about the bus route should include the students who miss it.
ex.zh: 关于公交路线的讨论应当包括那些赶不上车的学生。

tip: 动词是 discuss，已在本库。discuss 后不加 about，名词 discussion 后常用 about 或 of。

senses.en: a marriage ceremony

ex.en: The wedding is in the town hall.
ex.zh: 婚礼在市政厅举行。

ex.en: A school should not assume every family celebrates a wedding in the same way.
ex.zh: 学校不应当假定每个家庭都以同样的方式庆祝婚礼。

tip: wedding 是仪式。婚姻关系用 marriage。

senses.en: a thin string of cotton or similar material
to put thread through

ex.en: The button needs a stronger thread.
ex.zh: 这颗扣子需要更结实的线。

ex.en: A thread of the story is the late bus, not the joke.
ex.zh: 故事的一条线索是晚班车，不是那个笑话。

tip: thread 也可比喻线索。作动词是穿线。

senses.en: the act of finding something, or the thing found

ex.en: The discovery is explained in the last chapter.
ex.zh: 这个发现在最后一章说明。

ex.en: A discovery in the lab is useful only when the notes can be read by the next class.
ex.zh: 实验室里的发现，只有在下一班能读懂笔记时才有用。

tip: 动词 discover 已在本库。discovery 可数。

senses.en: the red liquid in the body

ex.en: The nurse stopped the blood with a clean cloth.
ex.zh: 护士用干净的布止住了血。

ex.en: Loss of blood is one reason a village clinic must be close, not an hour away.
ex.zh: 失血是乡村诊所必须在近处、而不是一小时之外的原因之一。

tip: blood 不可数。

senses.en: a series of actions
to treat or deal with something in stages

ex.en: Learning a word is a slow process.
ex.zh: 学会一个词是一个缓慢的过程。

ex.en: The process of cleaning a river includes factories upstream, not only the park in the city.
ex.zh: 清理一条河的过程包括上游的工厂，而不只是城里的公园。

col: in the process of｜在……过程中
tip: process 作动词是“加工、处理”，名词重音常在前，动词重音可在后。

senses.en: films, music, and other things people enjoy

ex.en: The entertainment starts after the speeches.
ex.zh: 娱乐节目在讲话之后开始。

ex.en: Free entertainment in the square still needs a toilet and a way home.
ex.zh: 广场上的免费娱乐仍然需要厕所和回家的办法。

tip: entertainment 通常不可数。具体一场节目有时可用 an entertainment。

senses.en: parents and children, or relatives

ex.en: My family has dinner together on Sundays.
ex.zh: 我们家周日一起吃晚饭。

ex.en: When housing is too expensive, a family may spend so much on rent that little remains for books or clinics.
ex.zh: 当住房太贵时，一个家庭可能把太多钱花在房租上，书籍和看病就所剩无几。

tip: family 作整体时谓语用单数；强调家庭成员时有时用复数。

senses.en: to want to know, or to feel surprise
a feeling of surprise, or something wonderful

ex.en: I wonder whether the museum is open.
ex.zh: 我想知道博物馆是否开着。

ex.en: Residents wonder why a new mall was finished before the leaking school roof.
ex.zh: 居民想知道为什么新商场比漏雨的校舍屋顶先完工。

tip: wonder 后常接 if 或 whether。

senses.en: something added, or the process of adding

ex.en: The new lab is a useful addition to the school.
ex.zh: 新实验室是学校有用的增添。

ex.en: In addition to more roads, the town needs pavements if children are to walk safely.
ex.zh: 除了更多的路，如果孩子要安全走路，城镇还需要人行道。

tip: in addition to 后接名词或 doing。

senses.en: to take to a place; to give a speech
to give a speech, lecture, or presentation
to produce the results or benefits that were promised

ex.en: The post office will deliver the package.
ex.zh: 邮局会递送这个包裹。

ex.en: Public transport projects must deliver clear benefits to local residents if they are to justify substantial investment.
ex.zh: 公共交通项目必须为当地居民带来明确的益处，才能证明大规模投资是合理的。

col: deliver on a promise｜兑现承诺
tip: 递送用deliver sth to sb；兑现承诺可用deliver on。

senses.en: to dislike very strongly
a strong dislike

ex.en: I hate waiting in the rain.
ex.zh: 我讨厌在雨里等。

ex.en: People hate a rule they do not understand more than a rule that is strict but clear.
ex.zh: 人们对不理解的规则的反感，超过对严格但清楚的规则。

tip: hate 后接 doing 或 to do。

senses.en: a large group of people in one place
to fill a place

ex.en: A crowd waited at the gate.
ex.zh: 一群人在门口等着。

ex.en: A crowd at a school gate is a design problem if the pavement is too narrow.
ex.zh: 如果人行道太窄，校门口的人群就是一个设计问题。

tip: crowd 作动词是拥挤。crowded 是形容词。

senses.en: a strong wish
to want something strongly

ex.en: Her desire to study medicine is clear.
ex.zh: 她学医的愿望很明确。

ex.en: A desire for a high score should not cancel a night of sleep.
ex.zh: 想得高分的愿望不应当取消一夜睡眠。

tip: desire 比 wish 更强，也更正式。作动词直接接名词或 to do。

senses.en: to rest with the eyes closed
the rest you get at night

ex.en: I sleep for eight hours on school nights.
ex.zh: 上学的晚上我睡八小时。

ex.en: Teenagers sleep better when phones stay out of the bedroom.
ex.zh: 手机不放在卧室时，青少年睡得更好。

tip: sleep 是动词或不可数名词。睡着了用 asleep。

senses.en: a piece of furniture, or a list of figures

ex.en: Please clear the table after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后请把桌子收拾干净。

ex.en: A table of bus times is useless if the last bus leaves before school ends.
ex.zh: 如果末班车在放学前离开，一份公交时刻表就没有用。

tip: table 也可指表格。

senses.en: to happen

ex.en: The delay occurred after lunch.
ex.zh: 晚点发生在午饭之后。

ex.en: Floods occur in the same streets when the drain stays blocked.
ex.zh: 排水口一直堵着时，洪水就发生在同样的街道上。

tip: occur 比 happen 正式。It occurred to me that... 表示我想到。

senses.en: to tell someone you are grateful

ex.en: I want to thank you for your help.
ex.zh: 我想谢谢你的帮助。

ex.en: Cities should thank the workers who collect rubbish before dawn, not only the people who design the posters.
ex.zh: 城市应该感谢黎明前收垃圾的工人，而不只是设计海报的人。

tip: thank 是动词，后面接人；名词用 thanks。

senses.en: to become a member, or to connect

ex.en: I want to join the choir.
ex.zh: 我想加入合唱团。

ex.en: A new road that does not join the bus network still leaves many people walking.
ex.zh: 不与公交网络相连的新路，仍然让许多人走路。

tip: join 后接团体表示加入；join in 后接活动。

senses.en: a reduction in price

ex.en: The discount is for students.
ex.zh: 这个折扣是给学生的。

ex.en: A discount that is not written down is not a price a family can check.
ex.zh: 没写下来的折扣，不是家庭能核对的价格。

tip: discount 作动词是打折。

senses.en: to pay to use something, or to employ someone
an act of hiring

ex.en: The school will hire a bus.
ex.zh: 学校将租一辆公交。

ex.en: Do not hire a driver who has already worked a full night.
ex.zh: 不要雇用已经上了一整夜班的司机。

col: hire sb to do｜雇某人做
tip: 英式 hire 可指租用。美式 hire 多指雇用，租用常用 rent。

senses.en: most important
a leader

ex.en: The chief reason for the delay was the rain.
ex.zh: 延误的主要原因是下雨。

ex.en: The chief cost of a new road may be the playground it replaces, not the stone it uses.
ex.zh: 一条新路的主要代价，可能是它取代的操场，而不是它用的石头。

tip: chief 作名词是“首领”。

senses.en: helpful for a purpose

ex.en: The map was useful on the trip.
ex.zh: 这张地图在旅途中很有用。

ex.en: A useful rule is one a new student can follow on the first day.
ex.zh: 有用的规定是新生第一天就能照做的。

tip: 说 sth is useful to sb，或 useful for doing。

senses.en: hopeful, or certain

ex.en: She gave a positive answer.
ex.zh: 她给了肯定的回答。

ex.en: A positive test result should be explained in words a family can understand.
ex.zh: 阳性的检测结果应该用一个家庭能懂的话来解释。

tip: positive 在检测里表示阳性，在态度里表示积极。

senses.en: a short piece of writing
to notice or write down

ex.en: I wrote a note to remind myself.
ex.zh: 我写了张便条提醒自己。

ex.en: A note in the margin of a shared textbook can help the next reader if the handwriting is clear.
ex.zh: 如果字迹清楚，共用课本页边的笔记能帮助下一个读者。

tip: note 作动词是“注意”或“记下”。

senses.en: to drop down
a drop, or autumn in American English

ex.en: Leaves fall from the tree in autumn.
ex.zh: 秋天树叶落下。

ex.en: If wages fall while rents rise, families move farther from the schools they wanted.
ex.zh: 如果工资下降而房租上升，家庭会搬得离他们想去的学校更远。

tip: fall 的过去式是 fell，过去分词是 fallen。秋天是 autumn，美式常用 fall。

senses.en: higher in position

ex.en: The upper floor is for the art rooms.
ex.zh: 楼上是美术教室。

ex.en: Students on the upper floor need a plan for when the lift stops.
ex.zh: 楼上的学生需要电梯停运时的方案。

tip: upper 是形容词，不单独作名词表示“上面”。

senses.en: a sudden increase, or a deep loud sound
to increase suddenly, or to make a deep sound

ex.en: The boom in bus use started in September.
ex.zh: 公交使用量的激增从九月开始。

ex.en: A boom in new flats still needs a clinic and a late bus.
ex.zh: 新公寓的激增仍然需要诊所和晚班车。

tip: boom 作动词是激增或发出隆隆声。

senses.en: having a value that makes something sensible

ex.en: The museum is worth a visit.
ex.zh: 这座博物馆值得一看。

ex.en: A long meeting is worth the time if it stops a road being built in the wrong place.
ex.zh: 如果一次长会能避免路修在错误的地方，它就值得花时间。

tip: be worth doing 用主动形式表示被动含义，不说 worth to be done。

senses.en: harm to the body

ex.en: The injury kept him out of the match.
ex.zh: 这次受伤让他没能参赛。

ex.en: A small injury reported early is easier to treat than one hidden until Friday.
ex.zh: 早报告的小伤比拖到周五才说的更容易处理。

tip: injury 可数。动词是 injure。

senses.en: an electronic machine for storing and using information

ex.en: The computer in the library is free to use.
ex.zh: 图书馆的电脑可以免费使用。

ex.en: A computer in a school helps only when students are also taught how to check a source.
ex.zh: 学校里的电脑只有在同时教会学生核对来源时才有帮助。

tip: computer 是可数名词。

senses.en: the outside or top layer

ex.en: The surface of the desk is still wet.
ex.zh: 桌面还是湿的。

ex.en: Oil on the surface of a river is a warning, even when the water below looks calm.
ex.zh: 河面上的油是警告，即使下面的水看起来平静。

tip: on the surface 常比喻“表面上”，和 in reality 相对。

senses.en: a person who trains a team, or a bus for long trips

ex.en: The coach spoke after the match.
ex.zh: 教练在比赛后讲了话。

ex.en: A coach who listens can improve a team more than one who only shouts.
ex.zh: 肯听的教练比只会喊的教练更能提高一支队伍。

tip: coach 也可指长途客车。作动词是“指导”。

senses.en: a machine that produces power to move something

ex.en: The engine of the old bus is loud.
ex.zh: 这辆旧公交的发动机声音很大。

ex.en: An electric engine changes the noise of a street, and it still needs a clean source of power.
ex.zh: 电动机改变一条街的噪音，它仍然需要清洁的电力来源。

tip: search engine 是搜索引擎，不是机械发动机。

senses.en: the activity of buying things

ex.en: We do the shopping on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我们周六买东西。

ex.en: Online shopping arrives at a door, and someone still has to carry the box upstairs.
ex.zh: 网购送到门口，仍然得有人把箱子搬上楼。

tip: shopping 是名词。商店是 shop，已在本库。

senses.en: a rule made by a government, or a scientific rule

ex.en: The new law limits plastic bags in shops.
ex.zh: 新法律限制商店使用塑料袋。

ex.en: A law that nobody can understand is hard to follow, even when its aim is fair.
ex.zh: 一部没人读得懂的法律很难被遵守，即使它的目的是公平的。

tip: law 表示法律时可不可数；一条法律用 a law。

senses.en: the details of where someone lives, or a formal speech
to speak to, or to deal with

ex.en: Write your address on the form.
ex.zh: 把地址写在表格上。

ex.en: An address that a delivery van cannot find is also a problem for an ambulance.
ex.zh: 快递车找不到的地址，对救护车也是问题。

col: address a problem｜处理一个问题
tip: address 作动词是“对……说话”或“处理”。

senses.en: a form of something that is slightly different

ex.en: This is the latest version of the form.
ex.zh: 这是表格的最新版本。

ex.en: An online version of a warning helps only people who can open it.
ex.zh: 警报的网络版本只帮助打得开它的人。

tip: version 是可数名词。

senses.en: a list of money owed, or a proposed law

ex.en: The electricity bill was higher this month.
ex.zh: 这个月的电费账单更高。

ex.en: A bill that limits plastic bags needs shops that will actually follow it.
ex.zh: 限制塑料袋的法案需要真正会执行的商店。

tip: 美式英语里 bill 也可指纸币。

senses.en: a computer for one person

ex.en: The lab has one personal computer for two students.
ex.zh: 实验室里两名学生共用一台个人电脑。

ex.en: A personal computer at home does not replace a quiet place to read.
ex.zh: 家里的个人电脑代替不了一个安静的阅读角落。

tip: 常缩写为 PC。表里没有这一条的音标，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: connected with a god or religion

ex.en: Visitors should be quiet in the holy place.
ex.zh: 参观者在圣地应当保持安静。

ex.en: A holy day for one community may be an ordinary school day for another.
ex.zh: 对一个群体是圣日的日子，对另一个群体可能只是普通上学日。

tip: holy 描述宗教上的神圣。不要用来泛指“很好”。

senses.en: an organization for education or research

ex.en: The institute offers a Saturday lab.
ex.zh: 这个研究所周六开放实验室。

ex.en: An institute near a factory can train local students for work that already exists.
ex.zh: 工厂附近的学院可以为当地学生培训已经存在的工作。

tip: institute 常指专科院校或研究所。institution 更泛，可以是制度或较大的机构。

senses.en: as good as possible
to make something as good as it can be

ex.en: Nobody expects a perfect first draft.
ex.zh: 没人指望第一稿就完美。

ex.en: A perfect score on one test does not show whether a student can work with other people.
ex.zh: 一次考试的满分并不能说明学生能否与他人合作。

tip: perfect 作动词是“使完善”，重音常在第二音节。

senses.en: to be the best or to get a prize

ex.en: Our team wants to win the basketball match.
ex.zh: 我们队想赢得篮球赛。

ex.en: A city does not win public trust by announcing a plan it never carries out.
ex.zh: 一座城市不会因为宣布一个从不执行的计划就赢得公众信任。

tip: win 的宾语是比赛、奖品或胜利，不是对手。打败某人用 beat sb。

senses.en: to become larger, or to raise plants

ex.en: Tomatoes grow well on this side of the wall.
ex.zh: 西红柿在墙的这一侧长得好。

ex.en: Cities that grow too fast may run out of classrooms before they run out of building plans.
ex.zh: 发展太快的城市，可能在规划还没用完之前教室就不够了。

tip: grow 的过去式是 grew，过去分词是 grown。grow up 表示长大。

senses.en: great happiness, or something that causes it

ex.en: The concert was a joy.
ex.zh: 这场音乐会是一件乐事。

ex.en: Joy at a win should still leave room to thank the person who passed the ball.
ex.zh: 胜利的欢乐仍然应当留出位置，去谢谢传球的人。

col: to one joy｜令某人高兴的是
jump for joy｜高兴得跳起来
tip: joy 作情感时常不可数。a joy 表示一件令人高兴的事。

senses.en: a container with straight sides

ex.en: Put the bottles in the recycling box.
ex.zh: 把瓶子放进回收箱。

ex.en: A box of shared books can keep a village reading when the library bus comes only once a month.
ex.zh: 当图书车每月只来一次时，一箱共用的书能让村子继续有书读。

tip: box 的复数是 boxes。

senses.en: a person or thing that protects
to watch and protect

ex.en: A guard stands at the stadium gate.
ex.zh: 体育场门口站着一名守卫。

ex.en: A guard at a school gate should know how to help, not only how to stop people.
ex.zh: 校门口的守卫应当知道如何帮忙，而不只是如何拦人。

tip: guard 作动词是守卫。be on your guard 表示提防。

senses.en: happening once a week
once a week
a magazine published every week

ex.en: The weekly meeting is on Monday.
ex.zh: 周会在周一。

ex.en: A weekly bus pass helps the student who travels every day, not only the one who travels once.
ex.zh: 周票帮助每天都坐车的学生，而不只是一周坐一次的人。

col: a weekly visit｜每周一次的访问
tip: weekly 也可作副词或名词“周刊”。week 已在本库。

senses.en: to cause death

ex.en: The late frost can kill young plants.
ex.zh: 晚霜会冻死幼苗。

ex.en: Dirty water can kill fish long before people notice a change in the colour.
ex.zh: 脏水可以在人们注意到颜色变化之前很久就杀死鱼。

tip: kill 是及物动词，后面直接接宾语。

senses.en: a small river, or a flow

ex.en: The stream runs behind the school.
ex.zh: 小溪从学校后面流过。

ex.en: A stream of cars at four is a reason to move the gate, not only to shout.
ex.zh: 四点的车流是挪门的理由，而不只是喊一声。

tip: stream 也可指数据流。作动词是流动或在线播放。

senses.en: enjoyment

ex.en: The game was fun, and we also learned the words.
ex.zh: 游戏很有趣，我们还学了单词。

ex.en: Fun at a festival should not depend on so much plastic that the square is buried in waste the next day.
ex.zh: 节日的乐趣不该依赖那么多塑料，以至于第二天广场被垃圾淹没。

tip: fun 是不可数名词，一般不说 a fun。funny 是“滑稽的”，不等于 fun。

senses.en: to move something toward you

ex.en: Pull the door; do not push it.
ex.zh: 拉门，不要推。

ex.en: It is hard to pull a cart of books up the hill without a second person.
ex.zh: 没有第二个人，很难把一车书拉上山。

tip: 门上的 pull 和 push 是一对。

senses.en: vehicles moving on a road

ex.en: Traffic is heavy near the school at four.
ex.zh: 四点钟学校附近交通拥挤。

ex.en: Heavy traffic outside a gate is a reason to move the crossing, not only to tell children to hurry.
ex.zh: 校门口车流大，是挪动斑马线的理由，而不只是催孩子快走。

tip: traffic 不可数。不说 a traffic。

senses.en: in the direction of; American spelling

ex.en: She walked toward the library.
ex.zh: 她朝图书馆走去。

ex.en: Attitude toward mistakes matters as much as the number of correct answers.
ex.zh: 对待错误的态度和正确答案的数量一样重要。

tip: toward 是美式，towards 是英式，已在本库。意思相同。

senses.en: behaviour that hurts people

ex.en: The school rule forbids violence.
ex.zh: 校规禁止暴力。

ex.en: News about violence should leave out details that teach a method, and still tell people it happened.
ex.zh: 关于暴力的新闻应当略去会教人方法的细节，同时仍然说明事情发生了。

tip: violence 通常不可数。

senses.en: covered with or full of water

ex.en: The path is wet after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨后小路是湿的。

ex.en: Wet coats in a pile stay wet; coats on hooks dry.
ex.zh: 堆着的湿外套一直湿，挂起来的会干。

tip: wet 作动词是弄湿。

senses.en: a large body that moves around a star

ex.en: Earth is the planet we live on.
ex.zh: 地球是我们居住的行星。

ex.en: A lesson about another planet is clearer when students can compare its day with ours.
ex.zh: 关于另一颗行星的课，如果学生能把它的一天和我们的相比，会更清楚。

tip: planet 可数。the planet 有时指地球。

senses.en: an urgent request, or a quality that attracts
to ask urgently, to attract, or to ask a court to change a decision

ex.en: The appeal for books filled the box in a day.
ex.zh: 募书的呼吁一天就把箱子装满了。

ex.en: The appeal of a late bus is simple: students can stay for the club and still get home.
ex.zh: 晚班车的吸引力很简单：学生可以留下参加社团，并且还能回家。

tip: appeal to somebody 表示吸引某人或向某人呼吁。也可指上诉。

senses.en: the fact of losing something

ex.en: The loss of the old tree changed the street.
ex.zh: 那棵老树的失去改变了这条街。

ex.en: The loss of a night bus is also a loss of safe journeys home.
ex.zh: 夜班公交的取消，也是安全回家路程的损失。

tip: loss 是名词；lose 是动词。

senses.en: following what has been done for a long time

ex.en: The traditional dance opens the school fair.
ex.zh: 传统舞蹈为学校义卖开场。

ex.en: A traditional recipe can change when the market no longer sells the old grain.
ex.zh: 当市场不再卖那种老谷物时，传统食谱也会变。

tip: traditional 是形容词。名词传统是 tradition。表里这一行的音标少了词尾，本库改用 espeak。

senses.en: coins and notes used to buy things

ex.en: I do not have enough money for two tickets.
ex.zh: 我的钱不够买两张票。

ex.en: Money spent on early reading support can reduce the cost of failure later in secondary school.
ex.zh: 花在早期阅读辅导上的钱，可以减少中学阶段失败带来的后续成本。

tip: money 不可数，不说 moneys 或 a money。

senses.en: something successfully done
The successful completion of a goal through effort.

ex.en: Winning the prize was a great achievement.
ex.zh: 获奖是一项巨大成就。

ex.en: Schools should recognise creative achievements alongside examination results to encourage a wider range of student abilities.
ex.zh: 学校应在重视考试成绩的同时认可创造性成果，以鼓励学生发展多方面的能力。

col: the achievement of goals｜目标的实现
tip: 具体成就可数；表示目标的实现时通常不可数。

senses.en: programs used by a computer

ex.en: The software saves the class list.
ex.zh: 这个软件保存班级名单。

ex.en: Free software helps a school only if someone can update it when it fails.
ex.zh: 免费软件只有在出故障时有人能更新，才对学校有帮助。

tip: software 不可数，不说 a software。表里这一行的音标是 soft，本库不用。

senses.en: used for the future or for a suggestion

ex.en: Shall we start the meeting now?
ex.zh: 我们现在开始开会好吗？

ex.en: A town shall not call a road safe until children can cross it without an adult.
ex.zh: 在孩子能不靠成年人过马路之前，城镇不该称一条路是安全的。

tip: Shall I / Shall we 用来提议。陈述将来现在更常用 will。

senses.en: actually existing, or genuine

ex.en: Is this a real diamond or a glass one?
ex.zh: 这是真钻石还是玻璃的？

ex.en: Real progress on air quality is measured in hospital visits, not only in official announcements.
ex.zh: 空气质量的真正进步要用就诊人数来衡量，而不只是官方通报。

tip: real 强调实际存在；true 强调与事实相符。

senses.en: having a thin edge, or sudden and clear

ex.en: The knife in the kitchen is sharp.
ex.zh: 厨房里的刀是锋利的。

ex.en: A sharp rise in the fare hits the students who already walk.
ex.zh: 票价急剧上涨，打击的是那些已经在步行的学生。

tip: sharp 也可表示正点：at seven sharp。

senses.en: a bank record, or a description of events

ex.en: She opened a bank account for her savings.
ex.zh: 她开了一个银行账户存钱。

ex.en: An honest account of a flood includes the families who lost homes, not only the official numbers.
ex.zh: 对洪水的诚实叙述包括失去家园的家庭，而不只是官方数字。

tip: account for 表示解释原因，或占一定比例。

senses.en: a person who is not named

ex.en: Someone left a notebook on the piano.
ex.zh: 有人把笔记本落在钢琴上了。

ex.en: Someone has to decide which bus routes stay open when a city cannot fund them all.
ex.zh: 当一座城市无法资助所有公交线路时，必须有人决定哪些线路继续开。

tip: someone 后面的形容词要后置：someone important。

senses.en: a complete lack of noise or speech

ex.en: There was silence after the question.
ex.zh: 问题之后是一片沉默。

ex.en: Silence in a meeting is not agreement if nobody was invited to speak.
ex.zh: 如果没人被邀请发言，会上的沉默就不是同意。

tip: silence 通常不可数。

senses.en: to receive sound, or to be told

ex.en: I can hear the bell from the playground.
ex.zh: 我在操场上能听见铃声。

ex.en: People hear about a flood on their phones long before they see the water in their own street.
ex.zh: 人们在自己街上看到水之前很久，就从手机上听说了洪水。

tip: hear 是听见的结果；listen 是听的动作。过去式是 heard。

senses.en: the line between two countries or areas

ex.en: The river is the border between the two counties.
ex.zh: 这条河是两县的边界。

ex.en: A school near a border may have students who travel across it every morning.
ex.zh: 边界附近的学校，可能有学生每天早晨跨过边界来上课。

tip: border 可指国界，也可指页边。作动词是与……接壤。

senses.en: a net of threads, or a system of linked pages

ex.en: A spider web hung in the window.
ex.zh: 窗上挂着一张蜘蛛网。

ex.en: The web makes a village library larger, but only while the connection stays up.
ex.zh: 网络能让乡村图书馆变大，但前提是连接不断。

tip: the Web 常指万维网。website 已在本库。

senses.en: used to make a request polite
to make someone happy

ex.en: Please close the window before you leave.
ex.zh: 离开前请把窗户关上。

ex.en: Signs that say please are not enough if the bins are too far from where people finish their food.
ex.zh: 如果垃圾桶离人们吃完东西的地方太远，写着“请”的标牌是不够的。

tip: please 可放在句首或句末。pleased 表示人感到高兴。

senses.en: difficult, solid, or needing effort
with a lot of effort

ex.en: This question is hard, but not impossible.
ex.zh: 这道题难，但不是做不出。

ex.en: Hard plastic that cannot be repaired becomes waste faster than a simple tool made of wood.
ex.zh: 无法修理的硬塑料，会比一件简单的木制工具更快变成垃圾。

tip: hard 可以是“努力地”；hardly 是否定副词“几乎不”，二者完全不同。

senses.en: a long story

ex.en: The novel is on the reading list.
ex.zh: 这本小说在阅读清单上。

ex.en: A novel about a flood can start a discussion that a chart alone does not.
ex.zh: 一本关于洪水的小说能开启图表单独做不到的讨论。

tip: novel 作形容词是新颖的。本条以名词“长篇小说”为主。

senses.en: the system of tracks and trains

ex.en: The railway station is two stops away.
ex.zh: 火车站还有两站。

ex.en: A railway that skips the town leaves the school bus to do the whole job.
ex.zh: 不停这个镇的铁路，会把整件事留给校车。

tip: 英式 railway，美式常用 railroad。

senses.en: able to judge well

ex.en: It was wise to write the time twice.
ex.zh: 把时间写两遍是明智的。

ex.en: A wise rule names who locks the door.
ex.zh: 明智的规定会写明谁锁门。

tip: wise 的名词是 wisdom。It is wise to do。

senses.en: a society or school for a particular subject

ex.en: The art academy is open on Saturday.
ex.zh: 美术学院周六开放。

ex.en: An academy that takes only the already confident students misses the point of a public school.
ex.zh: 只收已经自信的学生的学院，偏离了公立学校的意义。

tip: academy 可数。Academy 作专名时常大写。

senses.en: a round container for cooking or holding things

ex.en: The pot is still hot.
ex.zh: 锅还烫。

ex.en: A pot without a label in the lab should not be used.
ex.zh: 实验室里没有标签的罐子不应当使用。

tip: pot 可数。
